m2_definition.definition: A current rights-cleared Kyrgyz Post release complete for its declared source, operator, jurisdiction and time scope preserves six-digit strings, repeated directory observations and separately typed mobile postal objects. Exact captured artifacts, row identity, edition, validity and rights are pinned; reproducible full-data conversion, independently licensed point/route/area geometry with CRS/topology checks, administrative crosswalk review, civic-address/building-link review and privacy/provenance review are required by the existing KG promotion contract. Publish approved immutable data artifacts and verify the actual AGID loader/API before M2. Geometry need not be an official polygon: derived/virtual/none remain explicit and cannot substitute for required licensed geometry or create a civic-address/building relation, universal coverage or delivery entitlement.

definition_basis: The existing KG runtime Promotion section requires exact current artifacts, numeric/mobile object typing, immutable digests, validity, independently licensed point/route/area geometry, CRS/topology, administrative crosswalk, civic-address/building-link, privacy/licence and provenance review. The manifest lacked a named M2 stage. This definition retains those gates, all ten hard blockers and M1_metadata; it does not redefine M2 as code or a directory-only release.

markers: How to find out your postal code?

rights_review.review: The inspected privacy policy concerns visitor information and says site use indicates consent; no form, account, clickthrough or explicit contractual acceptance was performed. The media page offers media information access and an official-request channel, not a reviewed bulk postal-directory licence. Portal aims and item-level licences do not automatically cover post.kg. Exact directory terms/edition and publication authority remain unresolved.

quality_rules: The grain is a directory observation in area/city/group/array-position context, not a unique postal code, post office or current assignment. Report full-row/candidate-key duplicates and repeated numeric-code groups separately; never deduplicate silently.

Read only a bounded string/array/object literal without executing site JavaScript; reject duplicate hierarchy keys, executable expressions, prototype keys, unexpected shapes, invalid UTF-8 and schema drift.

Preserve six-digit strings and leading zeroes. The exact non-numeric mobile marker is a typed exception, not an invalid six-digit assignment, normalizable code or generated route geometry. Unknown non-numeric values remain unresolved.

The full captured directory is measured, not merely a sample; the seven UI area groups and row count do not prove complete current national/operator coverage. Publication/modified dates, HTTP dates, source version, record validity and retrieval time remain independent.

Repeat the directory once and compare literal digest and publication/modified metadata, independently of dynamic HTML. Unchanged bytes are repeatability evidence, not current assignment attestation or temporal validity.
Inspect public catalog metadata only; zero query matches are not national absence. Record per-query scope and exact item licence metadata without inheriting it into postal assignment authority.

No raw rows, addresses, numeric codes, PDF examples, credentials, source dumps or personal/property fields are persisted in reports. No cadastre, legacy nsdi.kg, paid service, model, runtime data pack or new publication destination is used.
